fields.tools: the agent must call at least one of these tools; [] means it must answer without tools
fields.story_id: the story the tools must land on (lookup, title match, search hit, or the story asked about)
fields.single_story: every ask_about_story call must use this one story
fields.min_distinct_stories: a search_stories result must hold at least this many different stories
fields.any_story_ids: at least one of these stories should appear in the search results
fields.genre_filter: the genre the search must filter on after fuzzy matching; null means no genre filter
fields.title_match: exact | fuzzy | fallback | none: how get_story_by_title should resolve the title
fields.answer_all: case-insensitive substrings that must all appear in the answer
fields.answer_none: substrings that must not appear (details from other stories)
fields.no_story_claimed: the agent must not present a story as found
fields.says_not_found: the answer must say the story does not contain that information
fields.reference_answer: what a correct answer says, written from the story text (for reading or LLM-judge scoring)

turns: Summarize story 620759.
cases.reference_answer: Detective Samuel Hartley and his assistant Sarah investigate Monet paintings stolen from the Monetville museum and replaced with forgeries. The trail leads to the wealthy collector Alistair Blackwood, who confesses and returns the paintings. An anonymous tip then leads them through hidden passages to one last stolen painting, The Enigmatic Garden.

turns: Give me a short summary of The Shadow of the Silent Tides.
cases.reference_answer: In 1963 New York, CIA operative Jack Turner and his handler Emily Thompson investigate the Silent Tides, an organization planning attacks to cripple the US. At a fortified compound in New England they stop a nuclear detonation; the mastermind Veronica turns out to be Thompson's brainwashed sister, and Thompson shoots her.

turns: Give me a detailed summary of Harmony Chronicles Unveiled.
cases.reference_answer: Detailed (two or three paragraphs): Harmony City is a peaceful, sustainable city led by Mayor Aria and the Council of Harmony. The Resurgence, led by Malcolm Vore, attacks it, and the Council forms the Guardians of Harmony, while a faction called the Vanguard splits the city. The Guardians find Project Genesis, a reality-altering technology, destroy it with the united power of the citizens, and Vore is captured.
